using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.HuggingFace;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ImageToText;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Test;

public class HuggingFaceServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithStringModel_RegistersKeyedService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model");

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var serviceDescriptor = Assert.Single(services.Where(sd => sd.ServiceType == typeof(IImageToTextService)));
        Assert.Equal(ServiceLifetime.Singleton, serviceDescriptor.Lifetime);
        Assert.True(serviceDescriptor is KeyedServiceDescriptor);

        var descriptor = (KeyedServiceDescriptor)serviceDescriptor;
        Assert.Null(descriptor.ServiceKey);

        var factory = Assert.IsType<ServiceFactoryAdapter<IImageToTextService>>(descriptor.ImplementationFactory!);
        var service = factory(serviceProvider, null!);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(service);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithStringModelAndServiceId_RegistersKeyedServiceWithKey()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model", serviceId: "test-key");

        // Assert
        var serviceDescriptor = Assert.Single(services.Where(sd => sd.ServiceType == typeof(IImageToTextService)));
        var descriptor = Assert.IsType<KeyedServiceDescriptor>(serviceDescriptor);
        Assert.Equal("test-key", descriptor.ServiceKey);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithUriEndpoint_RegistersKeyedService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText(new Uri("https://example.com"));

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var serviceDescriptor = Assert.Single(services.Where(sd => sd.ServiceType == typeof(IImageToTextService)));
        Assert.Equal(ServiceLifetime.Singleton, serviceDescriptor.Lifetime);

        var descriptor = (KeyedServiceDescriptor)serviceDescriptor;
        Assert.Null(descriptor.ServiceKey);

        var factory = Assert.IsType<ServiceFactoryAdapter<IImageToTextService>>(descriptor.ImplementationFactory!);
        var service = factory(serviceProvider, null!);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(service);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithNullServices_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
    {
        // Arrange
        IServiceCollection? services = null;

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => services!.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithStringModel_UsesProvidedHttpClientAndLoggerFactory()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockHttpClient = new HttpClient();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton(mockLoggerFactory);
        services.AddSingleton(mockHttpClient);

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model", httpClient: mockHttpClient);

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var descriptor = Assert.Single(services.Where(sd => sd.ServiceType == typeof(IImageToTextService))) as KeyedServiceDescriptor;
        var factory = Assert.IsType<ServiceFactoryAdapter<IImageToTextService>>(descriptor!.ImplementationFactory!);
        var service = (HuggingFaceImageToTextService)factory(serviceProvider, null!);

        // Verify service provider.GetService<ILoggerFactory>() was called (indirectly verified by no exception)
        // and HttpClientProvider.GetHttpClient was called with provided HttpClient
        Assert.Same(mockHttpClient, service.HttpClient);
        Assert.Same(mockLoggerFactory, service.LoggerFactory);
    }
}
